Worth Saving Up for with Friends
Aug 2026 • Family
A few of us waited until payday from our part-time jobs before finally trying this buffet. At first, I thought the 469k price might be a bit much, but after eating for a while, I realized there were more choices than I expected. My favorite part was the sauce station because everyone mixed their own dipping sauce differently. The desserts were just okay—I tried them once and went straight back for more meat instead. The claw machine wasn't working that day, so we gave up after a few attempts. We were so full afterward that the walk from Giảng Võ to the bus stop still wasn't enough to help us digest everything.

My Business Guests Asked for the Restaurant Name
Aug 2026 • Business
I brought a few clients here during a business trip to Hanoi because it was close to our meeting place. At first, I just wanted somewhere convenient, but my Korean guests actually said the beef suited their taste very well. The staff noticed we had international visitors and communicated in simple English, which made everything much smoother. They changed the grill regularly, and the charcoal stayed hot enough to cook the meat evenly without burning it. By the end of the meal, one of my clients even asked for the restaurant's address so he could come back over the weekend. It's rare to find a place that everyone at the table agrees on.

The Kids Loved the Corn More Than the Meat
Aug 2026 • Friends
We took the whole family here after an afternoon out, and the kids were immediately drawn to the food stations. My younger one kept asking for the cheesy corn, while the older one couldn't get enough of the marinated soft-boiled eggs. My wife and I were happy with the beef—it was thick enough to stay juicy without being hard to chew. The restaurant was packed, so we had to wait a bit when asking for extra vegetables, but nothing too frustrating. The tables were a little close together, which might be tricky if you're bringing a stroller. We still left with everyone full and happy.

Eating with a large group is incredibly satisfying.
Jun 2026 • Friends
My group of four visited iMeatU for the first time, and we honestly didn’t expect the buffet to be anything too special. However, we were pleasantly surprised by how extensive and diverse the menu was. From beef belly, beef tenderloin, and pork shoulder to fresh seafood like octopus and scallops, everything tasted fresh and delicious. I especially loved the marbled beef dipped in egg yolk and the grilled eel, both of which were absolutely outstanding. The staff constantly changed the grill, served the dishes promptly, and were incredibly friendly and attentive throughout our meal.
